selection_rule: Use the latest official non-draft, non-prerelease GitHub release verified on the access date, provided its publication date is on or before 2026-10-12. The observed latest release met this cutoff.
fixed_version_observations: Entity names/types and relation endpoints are uppercased during parsing.
Initial entity aggregation is keyed by title and type; relation aggregation by source and target.
Downstream description merge and community mapping use title-only keys.
Clustering normalizes relationships to an undirected graph and defaults to the largest connected component.

summarize_communities builds all level contexts before extending reports, so its normal context-building calls see an empty report DataFrame. This is a static control-flow observation, not a runtime experiment.
README describes maintenance mode and demonstration code, not an officially supported Microsoft offering.
Final entity processing drops later rows with the same title regardless of type and assigns fresh UUIDs; final relationship deduplication uses ordered (source, target).

The default final documents/text_units schemas do not require repository path, source line/character span or source commit. Internal TextChunk objects expose offsets, but create_base_text_units retains chunk.text only.
The default query adapter does not load TextUnit attributes. Sources context displays short_id and text; read_text_units derives short_id from the input DataFrame index, not source line numbers.
Local text-unit retrieval is gated by selected entities and their text_unit_ids; relationship expansion considers either endpoint and context is bounded by token allocations.

The default update loader detects new and deleted documents by title, returns only new_inputs, and stops the pipeline when no new titles are found. Same-title edits do not enter this path; deletion results are not consumed by it.

Default update workflows concatenate previous and delta documents/text_units; merge entities by title and relationships by ordered endpoints; append delta communities/reports rather than reclustering the entire merged graph.
Call-response caching is a separate layer from document delta detection and does not provide repository freshness guarantees.

Official Bring Your Own Graph documentation supports custom workflows over entities, relationships and, for relevant searches, text_units plus embeddings. This does not supply verified code symbol identity, typed directed call traversal, source locations or repository update semantics.

paper.title: From Local to Global: A Graph RAG Approach to Query-Focused Summarization
paper.role: Original research motivation and method; not evidence of v3.3.0 code-repository effectiveness.

code_retrieval_audit.scope: Static inspection of fixed v3.3.0 default standard/fast indexing, Local query, update loader/merge workflows, cache functions, and official BYOG documentation. No Microsoft code or model was run.
code_retrieval_audit.limitations: These findings concern the inspected default path, not all possible extensions, custom workflows or external program-analysis systems. No accuracy, latency, index-freshness execution or task-success result is claimed.
